mapper.select: SELECT u.user_no AS userNo , u.user_id AS userId , LENGTH(u.user_pw) AS userPwLen , u.user_name AS userName , u.use_yn AS useYn , u.role_no AS roleNo , ur.role_name AS roleName , CASE c.code_no WHEN 70030 THEN 'SYSTEM' WHEN 70020 THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE 'USER' END AS role , DATE_FORMAT(u.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS regDate , ru.user_name AS regUserName , DATE_FORMAT(u.mod_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS modDate , IFNULL(mu.user_name, '--') AS modUserName FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_no = u.role_no LEFT JOIN code c ON c.code_no = ur.code_no LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.user_no = u.reg_user LEFT JOIN users mu ON mu.user_no = u.mod_user WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo}
